worldcombat.skill.energyball.summary: Draw the life force out of the plants around you into a bright seed, then hurl it in a straight line: it deals special damage and may lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage, bursting into a small patch of growth where it lands. The more nature around you, the heavier the ball.
worldcombat.skill.energyball.use.0: A heavy hit while standing in greenery
worldcombat.skill.energyball.use.1: Mid-range single-target fire that wears down Sp. Def
worldcombat.skill.energyball.use.2: Leave a fleeting patch of growth where it lands
worldcombat.skill.energyball.description: At cast it draws from nature within %2$s blocks: each source adds %1$s power, up to 90 sources.
It has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The ball flies at %1$s blocks per tick, up to %2$s blocks, with a %3$s block trace radius; the bloom lasts %4$s and sheds about %5$s seeds; deeproot is currently %6$s.
worldcombat.skill.energyball.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.energyball.growth.0: From level %1$s the core rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
On: gathering radius +1.6 blocks, power per source ×1.3 and core ×1.06, but +4 ticks wind-up, +5 ticks cooldown and −1 block range — a heavy ball from inside the greenery. Off: faster and longer but shallow, for quick shots on bare ground.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it open fire from further away.
On: when there is vegetation around the caster that can be drawn from, this ball ranks higher. Off: it ignores the surroundings and ranks like an ordinary ranged attack.
